video_title: 與Tyrese Maxey一起講故事！我們聊了什麽？【Telfair的球員專訪】

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on Anthony Edwards' early development
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards was big and slow and trash
quotes.quote: This is when Anthony Edwards was big and slow and trash.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 那时安东尼·爱德华兹很大块，但是又慢又菜。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's specific request for burnt chicken wings
quotes.excerpt: just make sure the extra extra extra extra burnt
quotes.quote: He was like it doesn't matter, just make sure the extra extra extra extra burnt. I'm like no one eats burnt wings.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 他说什么口味都行，但一定要烤得非常焦，我心里想，没人会吃烤焦的鸡翅吧。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden's advice on staying true to oneself
quotes.excerpt: don't let anybody come in and make it to where I'm not being myself
quotes.quote: Don't let anybody come in and make it to where I'm not being myself on the basketball court.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 别让任何人介入进来，别让别人在场上影响你做自己。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Maxey's most memorable high school game against Jesuit
quotes.excerpt: the game that we had to go to State my junior year and we won
quotes.quote: Probably my most memorable high school game is the game that we had to go to State my junior year and we won. That was just a real surreal moment.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 高三那年我们必须赢下才能进州赛的那场，最后我们赢了，那真的是个梦幻时刻。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: John Calipari's 'Big Henry' treadmill drill at Kentucky
quotes.excerpt: he'll put the treadmill on the highest levels of speed and highest incline
quotes.quote: Cal had this drill where he'll cover up the rims and he'll make you go a one-on-one rebounding with a partner. Sometimes he'll partner the guards up with the bigs just to make us tougher. He'll shoot the ball up there and whoever got the rebound would get one point. Sometimes he'll make it unfair, he'll put us guards up against seven-foot bigs. He knew we would lose and the consequence of losing was he'll send us over to the treadmills. The treadmill was called Big Henry. He'll put the treadmill on the highest levels of speed and highest incline and you had to run as hard as you could for ten seconds. It was actually torturing, but it built character and it built the stamina.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 事情是这样的，卡利帕里有个训练项目，他会把篮圈盖起来，他会让你和搭档进行一对一的篮板对抗，有时候他会让后卫和大个子分在组里，只是为了让我们变得更硬。他会把球抛向中，谁抢到篮板就得一分，有时候他会故意搞得不公平，他会让我们后卫去对抗七英尺高的大个子，他知道我们会输，而输掉的惩罚就是他会把我们赶去跑步机那边，那台跑步机就叫大亨利，他会把跑步机调到最高的速度级别，还有最高的坡度，你必须站上去你必须跑，用尽全力气跑十秒钟，实际上简直是折磨，但它磨练了心志也锻炼了耐力。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: John Calipari's intense reaction before Maxey's college debut
quotes.excerpt: I thought I had a great preseason and great practicing, somebody had turned the ball over
quotes.quote: I thought I had a great preseason and great practicing, somebody had turned the ball over or somebody forgot to play, I think it was one of my close friends, Keion Brooks had forgot to play, and Cal was like that's your fault and I'm glad I have Ashley and Emmanuel because you're not playing the ball. Mind you it was my birthday that day, I had just turned nineteen. I was like wow I'm not going to play? I worked so hard to get here and I'm not even going to get in the game?
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 我以为我度过了一个很棒的季前赛和很棒的训练期，结果有人失误了或者有人漏了战术，我想是我的一位挚友Keion Brooks漏掉了战术，然后卡利帕里就说那是你的错，我只能说我幸好还拥有Ashley和Emmanuel，因为你别想上场碰球了。你要知道那天正好是我的生日，我刚满十九岁，我心想哇我居然不能上场，我付出了那么多努力才来到这里，我甚至连上场打球的机会都没有？

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: John Calipari's office window intervention during practice
quotes.excerpt: he opened the window to his office because he saw the play
quotes.quote: Kahlil Whitney comes down the court, he did four or five moves combinations, he shot a shot and Cal didn't like it. He didn't like when we didn't do pass shots. He opened the window to his office because he saw the play and he blew his whistle and he said no bucket doesn't count, go the other way we're not playing that way.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 我的室友Kahlil Whitney，他带球过场，是个很有天赋的家伙，他做了四五个组合动作，他拔起就投，但卡利帕里不喜欢这样，他不赞成我们在不传球的情况下投篮，他推开办公室的窗户因为他看到了这一幕，他吹响了哨子然后说球不算进，球权给另一边，我们不能这么打球。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Maxey's dedication to academics during his freshman year
quotes.excerpt: my mom was big on school, I'm big on academics
quotes.quote: I was going to class every single day. My biggest thing was I want to have a great freshman year. My mom was big on school, I'm big on academics, so I was going to class every single day. We played against Anthony Edwards, we knew he was going to be a number one pick. I had 19 points, 8 rebounds, 8 assists, 4 blocks, 2 steals. The next day we had class at 8 o'clock in the morning and I think it snowed. I was like ah no chance I'm going to class this time.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 当时我每天都去上课，我最大的愿望是过个很棒的大一赛季，我妈妈非常看重学业，我也很看重成绩，所以我当时我真的是面不打动每天都去上课，我们那是对阵安东尼·爱德华兹，我们知道他会成为状元，我拿下了19分8篮板8助攻4盖帽2抢断，第二天早上8点钟我们有课，而且我记得当时外面下雪了，我心想啊今天我不能去上课了。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Maxey's draft day expectations and the 76ers selection
quotes.excerpt: I think the highest I thought I was gonna go at the time was 12 to the Spurs
quotes.quote: For me I think the highest I thought I was gonna go at the time was 12 to the Spurs. I thought the Spurs they really liked me. I never even interviewed or anything with the Sixers, so I didn't think I would fall to 21. I never thought I would fall that low. I know when we got to pick 18, Rich Paul just tell you be patient, they had a plan. And 21 came, the Sixers picked me.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 对我来说，我当时觉得自己最高也就到12顺位去马刺，我觉得马刺真的很喜欢我，我们跟他们聊过好几次，我甚至都没跟76人队面试过，所以我没想到自己会掉到21顺位，我从没想过会掉到那么低，我知道当选秀到了第18顺位的时候，里奇·保罗就说你要保持耐心，他们自有计划，然后21顺位到了，76人选中了我。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Ish Smith's speed as Maxey's 'Welcome to the NBA' moment
quotes.excerpt: probably Ish Smith, he is the same height as mine, he so fast
quotes.quote: Probably Ish Smith. Ish Smith, he is the same height as mine, he so fast. I thought I was fast and I had shoot around that morning, we was playing the Washington Wizards, it was Ish Smith on the Wizards at this time, he was backing up Russell Westbrook. So we got in the game at the same time, it's my first time really come off the bench in the NBA and I'm stretching trying to get loose and Ish Smith is running full speed at me, hits me with an in and out crossover, gets an easy layup.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 可能是伊斯梅尔·史密斯，史密斯他跟我身高一样，他太快了，我本以为自己挺快的，那天早上刚参加完投篮训练，我们对阵华盛顿奇才队，当时史密斯在奇才队，他是威斯布鲁克的替补，所以我们两个同时替补上场，这是我第一次真正意义上在NBA替补登场，我还在拉伸着热身呢，史密斯就全速朝我冲过来，直接给我来了一个内外侧运球过人，轻松上篮得分。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's challenge to Maxey to score 40 points
quotes.excerpt: he said Tyrese you thought you could score forty tonight? I was like forty?
quotes.quote: He said Tyrese you thought you could score forty tonight? I was like forty? I didn't even score, I barely scored twenty. You want me to get forty? Then I had thirty-nine. I was like OK maybe I can do these things. He already had confidence in myself, but when someone to that stature and that ability has the confidence in you, it just makes it a lot easier.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 他问你能不能拿40分吗？他说泰瑞斯你觉得今晚你能砍下40分吗？我当时就说40分？我之前连20分都没拿过几次，你想让我拿40分？结果那一晚我拿了39分，我当时心想好吧也许我真的能做到这些事，他那会儿就已经对我很有信心了，但当一个有着如此地位和如此能力的人对你充满信心的时候，它真的会变得轻松许多。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's ritual of eating burnt chicken wings on the plane
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese why you never bring me any wings? Tell your chef to make me some
quotes.quote: I think one really fun one was my chef would make wings when I would go to the plane. I would have twelve or some just for myself. So then I get to the plane I sit across from Joel, I pull out my wings start eating them he's like Tyrese why you never bring me any wings? Tell your chef to make me some. So I said OK, what kind of wings do you like? He was like it doesn't matter, just make sure the extra extra extra extra burnt.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 我觉得有一个很好的就是我的厨师，每次我要上飞机时，厨师都会给我做炸鸡翅，我通常会带上12个左右，然后我上了飞机坐在恩比德的对面，我拿出我的鸡翅开始吃，他就问泰瑞斯你为什么从来不给我带点鸡翅？让你的厨师也给我做点，然后我说行啊，那你喜欢什么口味的鸡翅？他说什么口味都行，但一定要烤得非常焦。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: James Harden's advice on maintaining aggressiveness
quotes.excerpt: the best advice I got from James is probably be myself, don't let anybody come in
quotes.quote: The best advice I got from James is probably be myself, don't let anybody come in and make it to where I'm not being myself on the basketball court. He came in and I was like all right, well I didn't know how my role would change if I was gonna take a step back, but he made sure that didn't happen, that I stayed aggressive, that I stayed progressing, and he made sure of it. I would never change, I could change the way I play, but I'd never change my aggressiveness and who I think I am out there on the court because of him.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 我从哈登那里得到最好的建议可能就是做你自己，别让任何人介入进来，别让别人在场上影响你做自己，他别来的时候我心里想好吧，我不知道自己的角色会发生什么变化，我是不是需要退一步，但他确保了那种情况没有发生，让我保持侵略性，让我保持进步，他一直在确保这一点，我永远不会改变，我可以改变我的打球方式，但我绝不会改变我的侵略性，以及我在场上对自己的认知，这都是因为他。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Doc Rivers' instruction to pick up full court
quotes.excerpt: he said pick up the full court
quotes.quote: Then you had the conversation with Doc Rivers, he said pick up the full court. He definitely prepared me. Doc, Sam, those guys, Spencer, Doc's son, who's my player development, they prepared me for pretty much everything my first three years. I'm so thankful for them, still really cool with them, still cool with Spencer, I'm about to go to his wedding in a couple weeks. They really prepared me to be the person and the player that I am today.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 后来你和道格·里弗斯进行了一次谈话，他说你得去领防全场，他确实让我准备好了，里夫斯、Sam，还有其他人，Spencer，他是里弗斯的儿子，他是负责我的球员发展的，他们几乎为我准备好了我前三年所面对的一切，我很感谢他们，现在和他们的关系依旧很好，跟Spencer关系也很棒，几周后我还打算去参加他的婚礼，他们真的让我做好了准备，帮助我成为了如今的样子。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Maxey's twin nieces and the 'lucky' New Balance shoes
quotes.excerpt: I wore them on their birthday and we lost that game, they call me the next day
quotes.quote: It's funny the first time I wore those, I wore them on their birthday and we lost that game. They call me the next day and told me I need to wear them every single game until we won. So I had to wear them every single night until we won and I had a good game in them. That next night we would end up win, but it was really cool, they really enjoyed that, so I was very thankful that we did that.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 说来好笑，我第一次穿那双鞋的时候，我是在她生日那天穿的，结果那场比赛我们输了，她们第二天打电话给我说，我必须每场比赛都穿着它们，直到我们赢球为止，所以我每晚都得穿着它们直到我们赢，而且那场比赛我打得还不错，到了第二天晚上我们终于赢了，不过那真的很有意思，她们也很喜欢那个设计，所以我很高兴我们这么做了。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Maxey's custom New Balance PE designs
quotes.excerpt: they were all gray and they had Apollo my dog on them
quotes.quote: I had a PE from that same season, they were all gray and they had Apollo my dog on them, they had beware of the dog a little yellow tape. I had a South Garland PE, I had a Kentucky PE. South Garland PE was red white and blue, it had some gold on it, it was kind of from us going to State. I had an Iron Man PE, a PE that look like Iron Man Spider-Man. I had an Infinity Gauntlet PE, so like Thanos PE the shoe was all yellow, it had all the Infinity Stones on it.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 我同个赛季还有一双PE，全鞋是灰色的，上面印有我的爱犬Apollo，还带有写着小心恶犬的黄色胶带图案，我还有一双南加兰高中PE，还有一双肯塔基大学PE，南加兰高中的那双是红白蓝配色的，上面带有一点金色，灵感大概源自我们打进州锦标赛，我还有一双钢铁侠PE，那双看起来就像钢铁侠和蜘蛛侠，我还有一双无限手套PE，就是灭霸PE，鞋身全是黄色的，上面带有所有宝石。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Maxey's upbringing and the origin of his early training habit
quotes.excerpt: I grew up with both my grandmothers in the house, they both got up extremely early
quotes.quote: I grew up with both my grandmothers in the house, both of them, they both got up extremely early every single day. I used to sleep with my dad's mom in the bed with my dad's mom till I was six years old, six seven years old, and she wake up every single morning watch news, watch news, watch news, watch news. By the time I got to ten I went upstairs, so my dad's mom slept downstairs, my mom's mom slept upstairs. She never slept in her room, never slept in the bed, she only slept on the couch, she slept on the couch, I slept on the floor. She get up 4 o'clock in the morning, watch the news, watch I Love Lucy, watch all those black and white shows. So I had no choice but to get up. They were up every single morning and that's kinda who I became, someone who's a morning person up every single morning.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 我是和我的奶奶和外婆一起长大的，她们俩都在家里，她们每天都会起得特别早，我以前跟我奶奶睡一张床，一直睡到六岁，六七岁的样子，她每天早上都会起来看新闻，一遍又一遍，等我长到十岁左右我就搬到了楼上，所以奶奶是睡楼下，外婆是睡楼上，但她从来不在自己房间里睡，从来不在床上睡，她只睡沙发，她睡沙发我就睡地板，因为我不喜欢自己睡房间，她凌晨四点就会起床，看新闻，看我爱露西，看那些黑白电视节目，所以我除了起床别无选择，她们每天早上都起来，这也在某种程度上塑造了我，变成了一个早起人，每天早上都早起。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: How early morning training builds psychological confidence
quotes.excerpt: I'm working out three times before other people even get up waking up
quotes.quote: Then as I transferred it to basketball life, it was a psychological thing for me. I'm getting up this early in the morning, I'm working out three times before other people even get up waking up. And when I get to the NBA season, that's why my confidence is so high. I'm so ready to play, I feel like I worked harder than the period person in front of me. I got up early, I persevere, I did some that they couldn't do, and I deserve to be here, I deserve to perform at the highest level.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 后来我把这种习惯带到了篮球生涯中，这对我来说是一种心理上的优势，我每天这么早起床，我一天训练三次，而其他人甚至都还没醒，等到NBA赛季开始的时候，这就是为什么我自信心这么强，我已经做好了上场的准备，我觉得我比站在我面前的任何人，都更加努力，我起得早，我坚持下来了，我做到了别人做不到的事情，我理应站在这里，我理应打出最高水平的表现。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Maxey on the significance of his New Balance signature shoe
quotes.excerpt: I'm blessed that New Balance granted me this opportunity to have my name on the shoe
quotes.quote: I'm just blessed to have it. I'm blessed that New Balance granted me this opportunity to have my name on the shoe, that's a dream come true. That's number one I'm blessed, I'm thankful to New Balance for that. And number two is it helps me because it just makes me want to be even better. Being able to put this shoe on is a representation of not just myself but New Balance as well. Every single time I put this shoe on, every single time I lace them up and go out there and perform on the court, I want to go out there and do it at a high level.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 能拥有它我就觉得非常幸运了，我很庆幸New Balance能赐予我这样的机会，让我能把自己的名字印在鞋上，那是梦想成真，第一点就是我很幸运，为此我非常感谢New Balance，第二点是它实在在激励着我，因为它这会让我想要变得更加优秀，穿上这双鞋代表的不单单是我个人，还有New Balance，这是我们双方的一种合作关系，每次我系好鞋带上场，并在球场上倾尽全力去表现的时候，我想上场打出高水准的比赛。

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Maxey's dunk against Charlotte and his genuine reaction
quotes.excerpt: I dunked on one of the players on Charlotte, I was excited and I was trying to meme
quotes.quote: There was a moment recently last year we was playing against Charlotte, I dunked on one of the players on Charlotte. I was excited and I was trying to meme, but I also started smiling cause I was happy, it was my first game back. I had been out for three weeks, I had tore a ligament in my finger. I dunked it hard and I was trying to mean mug and I started smiling and I was just happy about the moment.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 最近就有这么个时刻，去年我们对阵夏洛特黄蜂的时候，我隔扣了夏洛特黄蜂的一名球员，当时我很兴奋，我本来想摆个霸气的表情，但后来我还是笑了出来，因为我太高兴了，那是复出后的第一场比赛，在此之前我因伤缺了三周，我的手指撕裂了一根韧带，我完成了一记重扣，本来想瞪对手一下，结果直接笑了出来，我当时纯是在享受那个瞬间。
